technicalObjective: Register the exact signal-ingestion validator command, allow the package script and V1 packet correction, and authorize deterministic boundary verification while excluding Workflow V2.

Ajv and other locked npm dependencies are provisioned locally or in CI before packet commands; no dependency or lockfile change is authorized.

P3-001 remains a schemaVersion 1.0.0 packet with modelRoute sol, defaultModel gpt-5.6-sol, fallbackModel gpt-5.6-sol, and allowedAgents exactly codex-engineering-executor and qa-verification.

No signal-ingestion service or test implementation, Workflow V2 routing, package-lock, scripts, schemas, production behavior, credentials, or external operations are changed.
The corrected V1 packet and exact package script pass deterministic packet, governance, fast, and whitespace checks.

changed-path inspection against the GOV-058 allowlist
no Workflow V2 or P3 implementation scope regression
